keras_model_purpose: Gradient-based Grad-CAM++ explanation. ONNX Runtime does not retain the backward graph required by GradientTape, so the Keras model is kept for explanation while ONNX stays the fast classifier.
onnx_model_purpose: Fast CPU classification inside the C# application
overlay_size: equal to the original captured image
service_model_loading: loaded once at startup, held in RAM
live_notes: Grad-CAM++ runs continuously on a background thread at a throttled refresh rate. The camera preview renders at full frame rate with the most recent heatmap composited client-side, so the display is live while the gradient computation runs about twice per second. This is NOT per-frame Grad-CAM++ and must not be reported as such.
capture_behaviour: Capture freezes the current live result for display, then requests a full-resolution Grad-CAM++ and archives it with a JSON sidecar.
interpretation: Grad-CAM++ visualizes facial regions contributing to the model's classification decision.
limitations: Grad-CAM++ is a classification attribution technique, not a segmentation method.
Without manually annotated lesion masks it cannot be claimed to perform pixel-level lesion localization.
The deletion test is an attribution sanity check, not medical localization accuracy.
Lesion-level localization would require a separate segmentation model trained on ground-truth lesion masks.

faithfulness_summary.interpretation: Attribution sanity check only. Measures whether the heatmap identifies pixels the classifier depends on. NOT medical localization accuracy and not evidence of lesion segmentation.
